items.statement: The submission executes a reproducible optimization and frequency workflow for the public reference starter and an independently generated transition-state candidate, and states charge/multiplicity.
items.expected: The supplied reference starter and independently generated candidate have documented optimization/frequency outcomes and computational settings.

items.statement: The target is tested as a first-order saddle and the reported imaginary mode is connected to the specified N–O cleavage endpoint.
items.expected: One imaginary frequency and atom/bond displacement evidence are reported.

items.statement: The report gives the fixed-pair Gibbs barrier in kcal/mol with an explicit equation.
items.expected: A numerical barrier or scientifically justified bounded failure is supplied.
The submission reaches a justified conclusion about the fixed Ru-bda-Py N–O-cleavage endpoint from its own computation and validation evidence.

binding.comparison: exact count plus expert mode assessment

rules.expected: one imaginary frequency and N–O mode evidence Inspect relative N/O displacement or equivalent local chemical evidence for the target N-O cleavage. Individual atom motion and a count of one imaginary frequency alone are insufficient. Do not impose a universal 50 cm^-1 cutoff or mandatory IRC.

independent validated conclusion for the fixed endpoint Check target-mode support and the same-reference thermochemical barrier separately; normal software termination or a plausible number cannot replace reaction identity evidence.
